records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#3
records.source: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. That bucket is the assay's own quality control: a well where 30% of vacuoles are off the power-of-two ladder has a segmentation problem, and its replication number should not be trusted.
records.context: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. That bucket is the assay's own quality control: a microplate sample position where 30% of vacuoles are off the power-of-two ladder has a segmentation problem, and its replication number should not be trusted.
records.translation: Rósettur með 3, 5, 6 eða 7 sýklum eru taldar í sérstakan ``non_power_of_two`` flokk sem er alltaf birtur og aldrei sameinaður nágrannaflokki. Þessi flokkur er eigið gæðaeftirlit mælingarinnar: ef 30% sýklabóla í sýnisstöðu á örplötu eru utan veldisraðar tveggja er hlutunin gölluð og ekki ætti að treysta fjölgunartölunni.

records.label: spacr.power_simulate.drop_low_cell_wells#2
records.source: The Poisson offset does part of the job: a well with three cells has a small expected count, so it does not dominate the *scale* of the fit. What the offset does not do is stop the well's read-fraction covariate from being paired with a response that is almost pure noise, and a screen with a long tail of thin wells is a screen whose covariate-response relationship is being averaged against nothing.
records.context: The Poisson offset does part of the job: a microplate sample position with three cells has a small expected count, so it does not dominate the *scale* of the fit. What the offset does not do is stop the microplate sample position's read-fraction covariate from being paired with a response that is almost pure noise, and a screen with a long tail of thin microplate sample positions is a screen whose covariate-response relationship is being averaged against nothing.
records.translation: Poisson-hliðrunin vinnur hluta verksins: sýnisstaða með þrjár frumur hefur lága vænta talningu og ræður því ekki *kvarða* mátunarinnar. Hliðrunin kemur hins vegar ekki í veg fyrir að leshlutfall sýnisstöðunnar sé parað við svörun sem er nær hreint suð. Skimun með langan hala af fámennum sýnisstöðum er því að meðaltala samband skýribreytu og svörunar við nánast engar upplýsingar.

records.label: spacr.qt.layer_viewer#2
records.source: The split is not tidiness. Five later features build on the layer model — ROI shapes read by Measure, a counting points layer, a label brush with timelapse track curation, orthogonal views with dimension sliders, and a synchronised comparison grid — and every one of them is a change to the model with a small widget on top. Putting the compositing rules in a ``paintEvent`` would make all five untestable without a running ``QApplication``.
records.context: The split is not tidiness. Five later features build on the layer model — ROI shapes read by Measure, a counting points layer, a label brush with timelapse track curation, orthogonal views with dimension sliders, and a synchronised comparison grid — and every one of them is a change to the model with a small widget on top. Putting the compositing rules in a ``paintEvent`` would make all five untestable without a running ``QApplication``.
records.translation: Aðskilnaðurinn er ekki til snyrtis. Fimm síðari eiginleikar byggja á lagalíkaninu: ROI-form sem Measure les, talningarpunktalag, merkipensill með ritun tímarásarferla, hornréttar sýnir með víddarsleðum og samstillt samanburðarnet. Hver þeirra breytir líkaninu og setur lítið viðmót ofan á. Ef samsetningarreglurnar væru í ``paintEvent`` yrði ómögulegt að prófa alla fimm án keyrandi ``QApplication``.
